answer.reason: The verses give Capernaum as the place where Jesus came to dwell and where he taught in the synagogue.

clauses.english: was where Jesus came to live after leaving Nazareth
clauses.quote: leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum

clauses.english: was where Jesus taught in the synagogue on the sabbath
clauses.quote: on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught

doubts: MRK 10:1 is marked but does not mention Capernaum, so it was left out.
The healings tied to Capernaum (the centurion's servant, the nobleman's son, the palsied man) are not stated as done in the verses given, so they were left out.
The woe against Capernaum (MAT 11:23, LUK 10:15) is a pronouncement, not an event, so it was left out.
